name: newsletter-dialog
title: Newsletter dialog
description: A newsletter invitation that behaves: it opens after a delay or scroll depth, asks for one email, and stays away for weeks once dismissed.
docs: trigger is "delay" (delayMs, default 20 s), "scroll" (scrollDepth, a percentage) or "manual" (you control open). It never opens on the first page view of a session (pageViews, or its own count in sessionStorage, against minPageViews), never while somebody is typing in a field or another dialog is open, never in a background tab, and never again inside suppressDays after a dismissal or a sign-up. storage is a pair { read, write } for the moment of the last dismissal, so you choose cookie or localStorage (the default); read may return Infinity for someone who must never be asked. onDismiss says how: decline, close, escape or outside. onSubscribe(email) may return a promise; success replaces the form in place and closes after a moment. When it closes, focus returns to whatever had it when it opened, such as your own button with trigger="manual". incentive is the line about what people get. NewsletterPanel is the inside on its own.
